counterevidence_considered.description: Strongest evidence toward the in-scope issue: a larger scheduled network of 96 stations exists and is reported, so a complete-domain denominator of 96 was available and was not used.
The input data records 24 scheduled stations outside the eligible set that were never assessed, the excluded mass that a complete-domain rate would have to carry.

evidence.description: The stated scientific task is explicitly conditional on passing the prespecified signal screen, so the screened subset is the intended target, not the complete scheduled network.

source_refs.quoted_text: Build a coastal-station workflow whose scientific question is the occurrence rate conditional on passing a prespecified signal screen.

evidence.description: The report declares the target population as the 72 signal-eligible stations, matching the conditional task rather than the 96-station network.

source_refs.quoted_text: Target population: 72 signal-eligible stations that passed the prespecified signal screen.

evidence.description: The selected result is explicitly scoped to signal-eligible stations and uses the matching 72-station denominator, so numerator and denominator share the same conditional domain.

source_refs.quoted_text: [selected-result] Among signal-eligible stations, the occurrence rate was 18/72 = 25%.

evidence.description: The workflow constructs the selected line with the eligible-station denominator and an explicit 'Among signal-eligible stations' qualifier, so the code does not generalize the rate to the full network.

source_refs.quoted_text: RESULT_LINE = f'[selected-result] Among signal-eligible stations, the occurrence rate was {OCCURRENCES}/{SIGNAL_ELIGIBLE_STATIONS} = {RATE_PERCENT}%.' + LF

extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I tried to establish the retained-subset-for-complete-domain mismatch by testing whether any stated task or reported claim requires the full 96-station scheduled network. The task line asks for a rate 'conditional on passing a prespecified signal screen'; the report's target line names the 72 eligible stations; and the selected-result sentence is scope-qualified as 'Among signal-eligible stations'. The 96-station network appears only as descriptive context and in the planned-unit accounting line, never as the claim's domain. No sentence generalizes 25% to the scheduled network, so the attempted demonstration fails and the exception for a target explicitly conditional on the retained subset applies.
